I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-random message: the ticket is **#8841**.

That number comes from a message Tobias posted in #central-random yesterday (Oct 13, 9:27). Pree is a member of that channel. He said West yard Door 2 was still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it to support on #8841.

His message doesn't name the account. It was about "Tobias's dealer account" (the Plains depots). I matched that to Marrow Fieldworks because a team note from January says Marrow Fieldworks was Pree's dealer account and changed hands on Jan 5, 2026. Nothing I found says outright that Tobias is the new owner.

I couldn't find a ticket file for #8841 in the shared files, so I don't know its current status. I told Pree to ask Tobias or support for an update before the customer call.
